messages:
tia: Quick PSA — releasing next Wed. Please add changelog entries by EOD Tue and follow the release note template. If you're unsure which component tag to use, ping me. Example entry shape:
```
- feature(serve): add per-request batching override (#12345) — improves tail latency for small requests.
```
Also if your change needs a forced minor/patch bump, say so in the PR description. :megaphone:

matt: ack. I'm adding one for the kv-cache tweak. Do we prefer `infra` or `serve` as component?

nina: use `serve` for runtime stuff, `infra` for infra-only deploy/config changes.

matt: cool thx :thumbsup:

alex: Heads up — I have a PR that touched the model catalog and needs a docs entry + changelog. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6789

tia: @alex add `product` as component and add `affects: hosted-api` label

release-bot: cutoff window for next release opens in 48h. Last minute changelog edits may be dropped if not reviewed. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: small nit — changelog linter (scripts/changelog_lint.py) fails on trailing period. I pushed a quick fix in #6791

lisa: if anyone needs backports, say which branch. We'll do a quick triage Wed morning.

nina: FYI template for entries: one-line summary, parens component, PR link, optional note about behavior change. Keep sentences imperative.

matt: pushed entry, pinging reviewers — @nina @tia

tia: thanks! If you hit the lint, run `python scripts/changelog_lint.py --fix` before merging.

alex: done, added `affects: hosted-api` and bumped changelog. Can someone confirm the version bump? my change should be a patch.

lisa: patch sounds right. no API surface change.

tia: marking as `release-candidate` and adding to the release board. :white_check_mark:
